definition.def: Your attitude to something is the way that you think and feel about it, especially when this shows in the way you behave.
examples: ...the general change in attitude towards people with disabilities. [+ to/towards]
I don't think it's fair to accuse me of having an attitude problem.

definition.def: If you refer to someone as a person with attitude, you mean that they have a striking and individual style of behaviour, especially a forceful or aggressive one. [journalism]
Your attitude of mind is your general way of thinking and feeling.
examples: Writing calls for a critical attitude of mind that he did not possess.
